verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, each with install instructions and full write/query samples in the quickstart. The API overview refers to 'official client libraries', and the official OpenAPI repo states the clients are generated from its spec. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and GA status for the Rust client (still listed as a beta release).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install an SDK: Python "# $ pip install turbopuffer"; TypeScript "// $ npm install @turbopuffer/turbopuffer"
The official client libraries handle this automatically and transparently
its official TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C#, and Rust clients are generated from the spec
